intro: Every public meeting where Melbourne Beach’s money decisions get made — the Town Commission first, then the county and school board that set most of the tax bill — plus the dates that matter this fall.

recurring.name: Melbourne Beach Town Commission — regular meeting
recurring.place: Community Center, 509 Ocean Avenue, Melbourne Beach
recurring.note: The five commissioners adopt the town budget and tax rate, and decide contracts and projects. The Commission also holds workshops and special meetings through the month. Recordings are posted on the town’s SoundCloud and YouTube.
recurring.source: “The Town Commission meets the third Wednesday of the month at 6:00 pm” — melbournebeachfl.org/Events-directory/Regular-Town-Commission-Meeting (checked October 2026).

dated.what: Town Commission workshop, 6:00 pm, Community Center — one item: a reserve fund policy.
dated.label: Workshop agenda

dated.what: Deadline (5:00 pm) for Florida Recreation Development Assistance Program park grants — up to $200,000.
dated.label: FDEP — FRDAP

dated.what: Early voting begins in Brevard County (through October 31).
dated.label: Brevard Supervisor of Elections

dated.what: Last day to request a mail ballot, 5:00 pm.
dated.label: Brevard Supervisor of Elections

dated.what: General Election, 7 am–7 pm. On the ballot for town voters: the $5.0 million stormwater and road bond, the mayor’s seat, the Indian River Lagoon sales tax renewal, the School Board’s 1-mill renewal, and state Amendments 1–3.
dated.label: 2026 amendments and referenda

unverified.name: Brevard County Board of County Commissioners
unverified.note: Meets at the Commission Chambers, 2725 Judge Fran Jamieson Way, Viera; upcoming dates are posted at brevardfl.legistar.com. The county sets 2.8643 mills of the town’s tax bill and funds the jail.

unverified.name: Brevard County School Board
unverified.note: Meets at 2700 Judge Fran Jamieson Way, Viera; schedule at brevardschools.org. Schools are the largest part of most tax bills (6.31 mills in 2025).

seasonal.banner: Budget season: from the summer workshops through two September hearings, the Town Commission writes next year’s budget and tax rate. In 2026 the workshops ran August 5 – September 9, with hearings September 3 and 16. Anything you want changed in the numbers gets said in these meetings — or waits a year.
